title: About
subtitle: A few words about me.
stack_subtitle: Some technologies and software that I use for my projects.
item1: Passionate about web development, I put my skills and expertise at your service to create modern, efficient websites adapted to your needs.
item2: With more than four years of experience as a self-employed person, I have had the opportunity to work on a lot of projects ranging from the creation of showcase sites for SMEs to complex web applications.
item3: My career path has allowed me to develop solid expertise in several technologies and frameworks, including Nuxt, Vue.js, React.js, JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, SQL, and many more.
item4: Interested in my services? Don't hesitate to contact me to discuss your project and find out how I can help you achieve your digital goals.
